order.step: 1 SMA bulkhead into the left wall
order.measured: nut on the inner face, spanner space 8.50 mm free (need 8.0), ok
order.note: the nut goes on before the battery plate, and the plate has a relief under the bulkhead. With the board fitted the free radius falls to about 6.7 mm, so a later re-tightening means taking the board out. That is why the nut goes on at step 1 and not at the end

order.step: 2 LiPo into the pocket, lead through the wall notch
order.measured: cell 45 x 20 x 8.5 in a 48 x 21 pocket, 1.0 mm of width clearance
order.note: the notch in the pocket wall is at x 5 to 12 and the cell starts at 5.5, so the lead exits under the plate

order.step: 3 battery cover plate onto the pocket
order.measured: skirt 1.25 mm wide with 0.35 mm clearance, plate top at z 11.0
order.note: the plate traps the lead and stands the cell off the board pillars

order.step: 4 board onto its five pillars, then one M2x5 into H1
order.measured: board 48.0 x 45.5 x 1.6, driver space 3.09 mm free (need 2.0), ok
order.note: tilted in about the bottom edge, 0.50 mm under the lips, 0.8 mm of lip engagement, 0.40 mm to the ribs

order.step: 5 vent plug and its plastic nut in the right wall
order.note: thread reaches 6.4 mm inside, nut 5.1 mm, 1.3 mm spare, so the nut is fully on the thread

order.step: 6 solar panel cable through the lid chimney, then pot it
order.measured: chimney 7.0 dia x 5.0 mm with a 3.2 mm bore, countersink to 6.0
order.note: the chimney hangs 5 mm into the cavity above the free right hand end of the board

order.step: 7 O-ring cord into the groove, 4x M3x8
order.measured: cord 2.0 mm in a 2.4 x 1.6 groove, drivers 17.52 mm free (need 2.0), ok; 17.52 mm free (need 2.0), ok; 17.52 mm free (need 2.0), ok; 17.52 mm free (need 2.0), ok
order.note: neck 2.7 x 1.2 keeps each screw in the lid

order.measured: 4 floor tunnels, tie 6 x 3 in the Y pair, cord up to 3 mm in the 8 x 3.5 X pair
order.note: the skin under a tunnel is 4 mm at mid span and 2.0 mm at the exits, the value the R2 exit radius leaves

not_proven.step: cord in the X pair tunnels
not_proven.why: the exits now carry the same R2 as the tie tunnels, but no working load is specified for a cord, so there is no load case to run

not_proven.step: pigtail cable from the bulkhead to the U.FL
not_proven.why: the keep-out and the planned path are checked as tubes. The last 7 mm of the drop to the connector is a straight end, not a cable bending over the board
